{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Ranulf_Tarkin.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Ranulph Tarkin, Governor-General of the Seswenna sector]]
{{Quote|Governor-General? You've come up in the galaxy, cousin.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]|<ref name="Recovery">''[[The New Jedi Order: Recovery]]''</ref>}}
'''Governor-General''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] title used throughout history by individuals governing a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was used by an individual to govern a sector under state of emergencies. 

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
{{Quote|There was the Sector Governance Decree, which appointed regional and planetary governors for each sector and system. This decree made the military system of Governor-Generals ubiquitous and permanent, creating a new power structure that would lead to the Senate being sidelined and ultimately disbanded.|[[Kol Skywalker]]|<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The role of Governor-General was created during the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], as part of a re-organization of the Republic's [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]]. Governor-Generals were appointed at the behest of the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], and their role was to co-ordinate military action with the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of a distressed [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[Time/Legends|times]] of crisis.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

In [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] was appointed by Supreme Chancellor [[Thoris Darus]] as the Governor-General of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in order to deal with the breakdown of order across the region. This appointment resulted in the militarization of the sector and the creation of the [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]]. Ranulph Tarkin's cousin [[Garvedon]] later assumed the position in [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]] after Tarkin became a member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Supreme Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] appointed Governor-Generals to each sector within the Republic, to help direct Republic's campaign against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Governor-Generals greatly improved the effectiveness of the contribution of the [[Planetary Security Forces]] to the Republic's war effort.<ref name="TEGtW" /> During the later stages of the conflict, Palpatine's [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] turned the wartime system of Governor-Generals into a permanent class of regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]]. These Governor-Generals later became the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> As these governors totally controlled military forces within their sector, they eclipsed the role of the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in military affairs.<ref name="TEGtW" /> During the reign of the Empire, the title of Governor-General was still used, somehow ceremonially, to designate Imperial sector governors.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

===Corellian sector===
{{Quote|Sal-Solo is the leader of a large political faction on Corellia, and has been elected governor-general of the Corellian sector.|[[Nom Anor]]|<ref name="Ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>}}
One noticeable exception in the Republic's Governor-General system was the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. In the Corellian sector, the position of Governor-General was a title that was permanently in use over centuries by the individuals who governed the sector. After the abolition of the [[Corellian empire]], the [[Diktat]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] traditionally assumed the position of Governor-General of the Corellian sector in addition to its role of [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of Corellia. The Governor-General of the Corellian sector was ''de facto'' the [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]] of the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]].<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>

[[File:Micamberlecto_CTD.jpg|thumb|180px|right|[[Micamberlecto]], Governor-General of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] prior to the [[Corellian Crisis]]]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Corellian sector became an [[Imperial client state]]. The Diktats were allowed by the Empire to continue to hold their title of Governor-General but their duties and prerogatives outside the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] were taken over by the Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Corellian sector.<ref name="SoF" />

After the fragmentation of the Galactic Empire and the fall of the [[Corellian republic|regime of Diktats]], the Corellian sector joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that appointed a Governor-General to rule both Corellia and the Corellian sector in the name of the New Republic. The first Governor-General, [[Micamberlecto]], was assassinated by Corellian separatists during the [[Corellian Crisis]]. He was then replaced by [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Marcha]] of [[Mastigophorous]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> The latter remained in office until the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. At that time, the appointed Governor-General system had been adjusted into a more democratic status. Marcha was voted out of office<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> by a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|vote of no confidence]].<ref name="AoC2:JE">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> The Corellian nationalist [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] was later elected Governor-General of the Corellian sector.<ref name="Recovery" />

Years after the end of the Yuuzhan Vong War, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] eventually normalized its administration of the Corellian sector by 
abrogating the appointed Governor-General position and leaving the worlds of the sector elect their own rulers.<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>
